overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not providing or approving minutes within the legal time limits, but the Board cured by approving and releasing them, so no additional relief was ordered.

allegations.summary: Board refused to release executive session minutes from 2011 meetings after the confidentiality purpose allegedly no longer applied.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide minutes in response to a request within the time period required by law.

allegations.summary: Board failed to create and approve in a timely manner the open session minutes of November 21, December 5, and December 12, 2011.
allegations.key_passage: took more than a year and a half to approve the minutes of

allegations.summary: Board failed to approve in a timely manner the executive session minutes from May 2, June 2, June 13, and July 7, 2011 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board waited a year and a half before approving its May 2, 2011; June 2, 2011; June 13, 2011; and July 7, 2011 executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly fails to review its executive session minutes on a regular basis.
allegations.key_passage: We remind the Board of its obligation to provide non-exempt executive session minutes within 10 days upon request, or if a review has not yet been undertaken, then not later than the body's next meeting or 30 days, whichever first occurs.
